sources.actualHeading: 普及版 字通: 偵; 常用漢字 11画; 字音 テイ
sources.inspection: The returned character definition gives investigating/looking into something, asking, and an investigator or spy. Its compound list includes 偵察 and its lower-position list includes 探偵, 内偵 and 密偵. It separately presents a phonetic analysis involving 貞 and historical 字訓 うかがう・とう.
sources.disposition: Supports the investigative/spy meaning range, eleven strokes and テイ independently of a substring in たんてい. Keep the frozen KANJIDIC2 on-list テイ and empty kun-list; the additional historical dictionary 字訓 are not new metadata or quiz selections. Use a labelled modern-shape mnemonic instead of adopting the historical explanation.
sources.limits: The Daijisen section returned attribution only, not a definition. Several historical passages contain gaiji image gaps; unseen characters and a full historical derivation are unverified. A listed compound is not evidence that every related word is common.

sources.actualHeading: 精選版 日本国語大辞典: たん‐てい【探偵】; 日本大百科全書: 探偵 たんてい
sources.inspection: The actual lexical entry distinguishes secretly investigating circumstances or a case, including that occupation, from an enemy-information agent/spy use. The encyclopedia says the occupational use often concerns someone outside the police, rather than an absolute exclusion of police in every context.
sources.disposition: Supports 探偵 たんてい as a detective/investigator and the separate investigative activity. Teach a useful private-investigator tendency and contrast 刑事, not a universal rule that 探偵 can never refer to police or can only be a noun for a person. The complete frozen JMdict family supplies the selected modern noun and transitive-suru senses separately.
sources.limits: The Daijisen and 字通 sections returned attribution only. Historical citations and the encyclopedia's detailed institutional, firearms and legal claims are not adopted as current general rules. No independently attested new sentence or measured frequency claim follows from this fetch.

sources.actualHeading: 精選版 日本国語大辞典: けい‐じ【刑事】
sources.inspection: The actual entry distinguishes criminal-law matters from the police-detective role. Other returned encyclopedia entries likewise identify plain-clothes criminal investigators. The 字通 compound entry only gives criminal matters.
sources.disposition: Supports the existing primary けいじ article's two-sense distinction and the bounded comparison with 探偵. The detective label overlap motivates a conservative direct quiz safeguard on the future new article; it does not erase the existing legal sense, change its N3 label, or establish unrestricted interchangeability.
sources.limits: Daijisen, MyPedia and Britannica headings without returned definitions are not verification. Particular ranks, organization, staffing and legal powers are outside the practical comparison and not newly certified.
